# Third-party inventory

| Material | Treatment | Terms / source |
|---|---|---|
| AMD VCU118 board XML, pin/preset metadata | Included subset with original notice | AMD copyright 2023; Apache-2.0, full text adjacent |
| Vivado 2023.2 and device support | Not redistributed | Install from AMD with applicable entitlement |
| DDR4, clock wizard, reset, JTAG AXI, AXI interconnect/converters | Configuration descriptors only; regenerate | No vendor HDL/netlist or IP license grant |
| RAMB36E2/other device primitive models | Not included | Use unchanged models from licensed Vivado installation |
| Pretrained FP32 and quantized weights | Not included | Provenance/redistribution permission pending |
| ImageNet image / input patches / derived payload | Not included | Obtain data through its authorized source |
| NumPy / Pillow / timm / PyTorch used by historical workflows | Not vendored | Recipient installs packages under their own licenses; offline evidence check uses stdlib only |
| Official competition guide | Original PDF/text not bundled as a new attachment | Existing report references/metadata retained |

No vendor IP cache or generated implementation is required to review the authored RTL and saved evidence. Configurations are included for inspection; no clean rebuild is claimed by packaging them.
